title: polypodium nummulariifolium
intro: Polypodium nummulariifolium, commonly known as Money Plant or Polypodium, is a species of fern found in tropical and subtropical regions, particularly in Asia and the Pacific Islands. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been reported to possess health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents present in Polypodium nummulariifolium include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
